claim: A fixed PyTorch sequence model can learn from training objects only to group independent lossy views of unseen finite predictive processes and reconstruct their frozen finite-horizon predictive signatures.

object_family.kind: minimal strongly connected four-state binary unifilar process
object_family.canonicalization: lexicographically minimal machine tuple over all 24 state permutations
object_family.minimality_witness: all four state-conditioned exact word-probability signatures through length eight are distinct
object_family.object_equivalence: identical exact uniform-start word-probability vectors for lengths one through eight

frozen_splits.selection: canonicalize and deduplicate the full counter interval, sort by canonical machine SHA-256, then take the first 192 objects without outcome-based replacement
frozen_splits.test_use: one sealed evaluation after source, manifest, thresholds, controls, and training protocol are committed

view_process.initial_state: independent uniform draw for every trajectory
view_process.independence: every view uses a disjoint SHA-256-derived PRNG subtree; no latent trajectory, initial-state draw, mask, or corruption draw is shared

learner.pooling: DeepSets mean over independently encoded trajectories
learner.decoder: separate softmax segment for each word length one through eight
learner.loss: equal-weight predictive cross entropy plus InfoNCE over independent same-object views at temperature 0.1
learner.checkpoint_policy: score epoch 32 only; no early stopping or test-aware selection

engine_contract.julia: exact rational canonicalization, minimality, predictive signatures, Graphs strong connectivity, and hard-negative verification
engine_contract.jax: independent manifest reconstruction, batched exact/empirical trajectory distributions, split controls, and finite leakage census
engine_contract.pytorch: GRU/DeepSets learning, predictive decoder, clustering, controls, and torch.func temporal-sensitivity receipt

blocked_consumers: QIT engine stages or four-substage derivation
Axis0, FEP, physics, life, or consciousness
